name: Velvet Nocturne
author: Sweepercom
description: A seductive gothic-purple profile with a cinematic veil loading sequence, stained-glass gradients, velvet panels and jewel-like character cards.

components.name: Nocturne backdrop
components.blurb: The deep purple page background, its lattice texture, and the default text colour.

components.name: Profile layout & identity
components.blurb: The grid the hero, panels and credit are placed on, plus the username, follower count and badges. Includes its tablet and mobile layout.

components.name: Veil loading sequence
components.blurb: The opening velvet-curtain screen and its decorative motion.

components.name: Cathedral hero
components.blurb: The stained-glass hero, title treatment, and optional portrait slot.

components.name: Profile content panels
components.blurb: The status panel, section links, dossier, and social-contact content.

components.name: Header, menus and controls
components.blurb: The site header, mobile navigation, user menu, notifications, and follow controls.

components.name: Reliquary character gallery
components.blurb: The character heading, jewel-like cards, filters, and pagination treatment.

components.name: Template credit
components.blurb: A subtle credit line at the base of the profile.

assets.label: Optional transparent hero portrait
assets.placement: Add an img with class vn-hero-art inside the vn-hero element

notes: The loading veil is decorative and never receives pointer events.
Animations are disabled for visitors who prefer reduced motion.
No CSS background images or custom properties are used.
Every component carries its own responsive and reduced-motion rules, so parts can be added or removed independently.
